Ask the organism

It answers in this tab. The code below is the organism's own exact reader, the same file node bin/brain.mjs ask runs, copied byte for byte: no model, no server, no token. A question it does not carry is refused with its route printed, never guessed.
act/exact-read.mjs c66443d035b7 tasks/exact.mjs ede0ce88f1ad
ready. type a question, or pick one below.
brain ask dilation >
Every answer prints how it was reached: route (which path answered), provenance (exact: computed with BigInt rationals, never rounded), model (none: no language model was called), and the nanoseconds per ask measured on YOUR device (median of 7 timed batches of the same ask). The same question on the command line: node bin/brain.mjs ask dilation "what is 17 times 23" --provider null. The distance to the frontier is on the ladder, from the verdict files.
